original_target.title: Ordinary posterior contraction for heavy-tailed neural-network priors

scope_comparison: Ordinary alpha=1 unclipped posterior contraction for arbitrary design distribution and the prescribed deep common-scaling prior remains unmatched. JMLRTheorem13 uses a product prior on f and unknown variance, unlike fixed known variance. The June2026 source explicitly leaves rho=1 random design open; the October theorem fixes eta<1 and a different shallow hierarchical prior.
